title: “I Just Don’t Want My Work Being Fed Into The AI Blender”: Queer Artists on Refusing and Resisting Generative AI
reasoning: The paper provides an empirical study of the ethical concerns and value systems of queer artists in relation to Generative AI. It explores ethical dilemmas regarding data consent, labor exploitation, and the mismatch between community-centric queer values and the capitalist, extractive models of AI development.
